name: Pulse MCP
description:
Pulse turns documents into clean, structured data inside Claude. Point it at any document (PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PNG, etc.) and get back accurate markdown, tables, and JSON. No copy-paste, no manual transcription.

With the Pulse connector you can:
- Extract a document's full content as markdown or HTML.
- Pull structured fields by applying a JSON schema (or have Pulse generate one for you).
- Extract tables, including charts converted to tables.
- Split a long document into topic-based page ranges.
- Batch-extract many documents or run a saved extraction pipeline.

Long-running extractions are handled asynchronously: the connector returns a job you can poll for the result. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 - sign in with your Pulse account and approve access; no API key to manage. Usage draws on your Pulse organization's credits.

Full API details: https://docs.runpulse.com

_published_faq.name: How do I add Pulse MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Pulse MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.runpulse.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Pulse MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pulse MCP provides these MCP tools: apply_schema, batch_extract, extract, extract_tables, generate_schema, get_job, run_pipeline, and split_document.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Pulse MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Pulse MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Pulse MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pulse MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Pulse MCP is developed by Pulse. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
